body:
Well seeing as how my week to date has been horrible, with Superman: Ride Of Steel at Six Flags New England crashing and me being sick as a dog, hopefully the release of Coruscant can save the day.  Red84 Josh Radke is running a non-sanctioned Sealed Deck tournament and of course I’m ready to go.  I get there at about 5:30 after getting sadly lost trying to sneak around rush hour traffic in Bristol.  I hear it from everyone, I get over it, get my boxes, begin opening.  Look at the bottom of this thing for my list of pulls.  While I’m here I decide to get a box of Raw Deal: Backlash.  Turns out to be a good idea.  But I digress.  6:00 rolls around, people come to order.  It turns out that there’s 12 players and this is gonna be a short tournament, since people have to leave at nine.  I pull light side out of a hat (rather, an empty box of Coruscant) and sit down with Josh, Charlie Hoffman, and a few other guys to draft.  12 players, 6 people per table, it just worked out.  Notable at the other table were Dan and Pat Long, Steve Brentson, and Frank, our local supplier.  We had 2 Tatooine packs each, 4 Coruscant.



First pack, Tatooine, it’s a dark side rare that I laughed at, I think it was A Million Voices Crying Out.  I mumble something about bad quality and grab Mos Espa.  Get my next choice from Charlie (I’m between Charlie and Josh)  He gives me a Padme.  I smile, take it, pass.  As the packs dwindle, I notice no one taking the podrace stuff.  I decide to mop some of it up, at the very least the high destiny stuff.  Good plan, or so it seemed.  Next Tatooine pack I open I pull Anakin’s, and pray Charlie gets the podrace.  He doesn’t, in fact, no one did.  So that strat is dead.  Somewhere in here I remember to get characters with ability regardless and end up grabbing Caldera Righim, Grugnak, Loci, plus some sites and the more useful interrupts.  I ended up getting stuck with 4 rule cards.  Oh well.



First Coruscant pack, Josh hands me the Jedi Council Chamber.  Bingo, I have a starting location.  I had grabbed Ki-Adi-Mundi from my pack, so I was beginning to get a good feeling.  Got a sense, couple other goodies including Mindful Of The Future and Security Control.  This gives me a bad feeling, if people are passing these, what are they pulling???  Hm.  Oh well.  Next pack, I pass P-60 to Josh.  Even trade I’d say.  I get passed Madakor, then two consecutive packs with a Republic Cruiser in it.  So I grab those, and I coulda sworn I grabbed Coruscant, but I didn’t because I’m a scrub like that.



Third pack, I open it up and see Shaft himself staring back at me, which of course gets me all giddy, so everyone demands to see what I got, so I flash him, and people don’t care, because only Josh and I know I have the Chamber, and only I know I have Padme hidden away.  I remember getting Tatooine and Malastare while I was in there, but I don’t remember much else.  4th pack, I kindly ask Josh for a Qui-gon, but he tanks the play and pulls a Panaka’s Blaster that he needs for the set.  So of course I grab it to trade it to him later.  I flesh out my deck with some senators, Odin Neslour, and a card which I later learned was 100% tech, Thrown Back.  Traffic control during your opponent’s turn, I love it.  We customize, which is easy for me, I toss all the duplicate locations, podracing stuff with low destiny, and I end up with about 45 cards for a 40 card deck, which is easy to cut.  I’m the first one ready, and a little scouting reveals that no one pulled a Maul, so the Padme/Mace trick is gonna work.  Now I didn’t really look at anyone’s cards, just yelled over to the other table “Anyone pull a Maul?”  They responded with a unanimous “NO!” so I assumed it was safe.  Here’s my decklist:

Tatooine: Watto’s Junkyard



First game is against Charlie.  He starts the Junkyard (I think, Tatooine site that’s 2 for dark, one for light)  I draw Ki and Mace opening hand, plus a location.  He activates, he draws.  I activate, dive for a docking bay (Coruscant one) and pop my location, City Outskirts.  I draw 2 of my 5 force, Thrown Back and Padme respectively.  He saves force this time, but deploys the Senate.  I groan.  My turn, activate a bunch, pop Shaft to the Chamber, deploy Thrown Back which he spends a long time reading while I draw up.  I throw back the 7 destiny and a couple other things on his turn.  He pops some senators and TC-14.  We are not amused.  Long story short, Shaft and TC hang out in the council chamber while he drains at the senate and I drain in space after deploying Tatooine, plus Ki-Adi at Watto’s hood with Padme.  I win the drain war



FW 2(+12)

The good: Free drain at Tatooine

The bad: Beating a friend

The ugly: Shaft held at bay by a freakin 3PO clone.  ::sigh::



Josh’s game ends up going to time, so we decide there’d only be one more game.  Which is good and bad, since I’m tied for top seed, but I wanna play more too.  But I’ll be content with having cake, but not being able to eat it.  I play against Jeremy Dallaire, another good friend.



Same start on my end, he starts Senate.  I begin to cry, since I have a total of 3 senators in the deck.  But I draw Ki again, and get Mace on my first draw phase.  I get all the effects out, end up grabbing squabbling delegates, he was using it too much.  I’m retrieving like mad, ‘cuz I eventually win the senate war and retrieve with the force drain at Malastare/Wookiee senator, also retrieving with Ki at the Marketplace.  I also have Thrown back out.  This one is short, though a possible comeback was afoot when he deployed Naboo and two trade federation ships with some pilots.  I pop Madakar and her copilot, and a Naboo pilot for fodder and hack away, tracking my 7 each time.  I eventually win that war too, don’t have a lot of cards on table, keep retrieving, painful win.



FW +26  4(+38)

The good: Retrieval does happen in Ep 1 Sealed?

The bad: Half my retrieval came from his card.

The ugly: I won by 26 in a 40 card sealed deck.  I rubbed it in, didn’t have to retrieve as much, etc.



I come in first, one of two undefeateds.  I get my 5 packs, get a Qui-gon out of it, toss a Panaka’s at Josh, seeing as how I now have three.  Always good to help friends out.  Everyone had fun, we gotta do more of these.  Now, as promised, my pulls from two boxes, 5 packs, and some trades (not the sealed though):

summary: John Mullarkey won a 12-player non-sanctioned Coruscant release-party booster draft run by Josh Radke in Terryville, Connecticut, on 8 August 2001, going 2–0 (4 (+38)) with a Light deck built around the Jedi Council Chamber.
notes: New hub 'August 2001 Terryville tournament' (List has Terryville events in August 2000 and March 2001, none in August 2001). Date from the title (8-8-01); place from the title. Runner: 'Red84 Josh Radke' (existing page; Squadron Member Red 84, Terryville).

The report calls it 'a non-sanctioned Sealed Deck tournament', but players drafted 2 Tatooine and 4 Coruscant packs at two six-player tables (40-card decks). No Coruscant or Tatooine draft format on [[Formats]]; event_format null.
Only two rounds were played (people had to leave at nine). Winner: 'I come in first, one of two undefeateds'; the other undefeated player is not named.

Game 1 opponent 'Charlie' identified as Charlie Hoffman from the same report ('sit down with Josh, Charlie Hoffman, and a few other guys to draft'; author sat between Charlie and Josh); linked to existing [[Charlie Hoffman]] (Connecticut player). Jeremy Dallaire has no page.
Full 40-card decklist included in the report, plus a list of the author's Coruscant pulls.
Others named at the event: Dan and Pat Long, Steve Brentson, 'Frank, our local supplier' (no results).
Byline 'John "Scythykins" Mullarkey' → existing [[John Mullarkey]] (DeckTech handle Scythe).
'I flash him' refers to showing a card; no hold.
